system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Helen Stoner, a pale, grey-faced woman of thirty in a dark travelling dress and mud-spattered jacket, raising her veil with trembling hands","action":"Shrinking back into her chair as Holmes leans forward in his dressing-gown and gently pats her forearm, his sharp eyes sweeping over her","setting":"Sherlock Holmes's sitting room at 221B Baker Street, cluttered desk by the window, coal fire glowing in the grate","secondaryElements":"Dr. Watson in frock-coat seated nearby watching with concern; veiled bonnet and return train ticket resting on her lap; gaslit lamp on the mantel","mood":"Tense, intimate, restrained unease with a gothic undertone of fear","timeOfDay":"Morning under dim grey winter daylight from the window","composition":"Medium two-shot framing Holmes and the visitor by the fireside, with Watson slightly out of focus at the edge, the window light falling softly across the room"}
